factor.hypothesis: Companies with stronger strictly point-in-time audited annual net earnings growth subsequently have stronger forward net excess returns.
factor.input_field: audited consolidated annual net profit attributable to common shareholders; if consolidated not available, exclude rather than mix scopes
factor.comparison: same company, identical scope and currency, latest two consecutive audited 12-month financial years; require both profits > 0; growth=(latest_profit/prior_profit)-1
factor.rank_rule: highest positive annual growth; deterministic tie-break by verified ticker in ascending order; no absolute growth cutoff beyond positivity
factor.selection: top 10 eligible stocks; if fewer than 10, hold 100% cash, and record why
factor.rebalancing: once per calendar quarter at first market session after all signal-date facts are known; select at prior market-session close and model purchase at next official EGX session close; hold until next quarter's analogous close
factor.holding_period: quarterly, no discretionary exit, no intraperiod rule changes
factor.cash_return: 0 in primary test; no invented Treasury bill yield
factor.corporate_actions: require split and share-count adjustment documentation; quarantine affected rows and preserve raw source

point_in_time.source_preference: official EGX issuer disclosure and its timestamp, then separately official quarter/annual market report, stored with source URLs or original PDF checksums
point_in_time.availability_date_rule: Use earliest independently verifiable public dissemination timestamp for the exact issuer earnings figure. If only the market-report issue time is verifiable but public release is not, mark UNKNOWN and exclude.
point_in_time.first_usable_signal: first trading decision made after public timestamp plus a full next exchange session; never the publication day itself
point_in_time.revisions: append-only versions, original and restated values separated; use only the version actually public at signal time
point_in_time.identity_rule: issuer legal name and source name must both match a dated official issuer-symbol mapping, with an independent second identity check (official filing or EGX listing record); manual approval logged; no ISIN inference
point_in_time.null_policy: unverified publication, scope, currency, year, company identity, or unresolved corporate action => NOT_ELIGIBLE; no imputation

eligibility.universe: all officially listed EGX ordinary equities, historical as-of-date constituents only; no survivorship-future constituents
eligibility.required_price_history: official EGX close/volume data as of signal date and all subsequent hold dates
eligibility.liquidity: ADV20 >= EGP 5000000 using preceding 20 verified completed EGX sessions, excluding current signal-day information when not yet public
eligibility.weighting: equal initial gross EGP positions, cash remainder if a name fails liquidity, track actual fractional units deterministically
eligibility.required_fundamental_completeness: two comparable annual audited net profits per issuer with independently verified first public timestamps

data_activation_gate.minimum_report_audit: five distinct year-stamped official EGX Annual/Quarter market reports across >=5 years, including >=2 Arabic ARB documents and independent publication-date evidence checks
data_activation_gate.pilot_audit: manual double extraction of >=30 issuer observations across >=3 report years and both language types, each with second reviewer
data_activation_gate.acceptance: 100% correct issuer identity and financial period/timestamp classification; >=98% exact net profit/currency/scope numeric agreement; all mismatches quarantined
data_activation_gate.coverage_required: at least 60 unique verifiably identified eligible issuers per evaluation year and at least 20 with both consecutive annual reports; otherwise NOT_TESTABLE
data_activation_gate.current_state: NOT_MET; only one library-accessible 2020 ENG report inspected and no ARB report or issuer-level public timestamp verified

evaluation.forward_paper_only_after_validation: not before 2026-11-07, subject to availability of new official bulletins and market-calendar checks
evaluation.benchmark: same signal-date, point-in-time eligible universe, equal-weight, quarterly rebalanced, identically costed and using identical fill/exit assumptions; report cash-only baseline separately
evaluation.costs_rule: Apply costs at buys/sells based on actual traded shares/notional and ADV20 available as of transaction; never approximate with portfolio turnover alone; missing or zero ADV => no trade, not zero cost
evaluation.returns_rule: calculate only after frozen prereg and complete data audit; no outcomes viewed for rule design
evaluation.missing_price_rule: do not silently drop a losing or missing position; quarantine and report counts, bound outcomes conservatively, no future-conditioned eligible universe
evaluation.risk_free_rate: unknown until official historical CBE data is verified; primary excess versus equally costed universe, not risk-free Sharpe
evaluation.inference: calendar-quarter block bootstrap with 10000 draws, seed 20261106, one-sided lower confidence bound on validation net excess
evaluation.multiple_testing: single new factor; use conservative one-sided family-wise alpha 0.001 for this candidate, and do not claim global multiplicity control until all previously tested family counts are exhaustively registered; freeze count and recompute Bonferroni alpha <= 0.05 / cumulative_count if stricter
evaluation.pass_rule: validation >= 12 nonmissing quarters, development positive mean net excess, validation positive mean net excess, lower bootstrap bound > 0 at the stricter registered family-wise alpha, zero material look-ahead exceptions, all data activation and audit gates pass; advancement permits only forward paper observation, never executable trading

anti_tuning: Parameters and tests are immutable after this prereg file is created; any remediation creates a new version and cannot re-label already inspected validation as unseen.
